create.name: don Oscar Miro-Quesada
create.bio:
Oscar Miro-Quesada Solevo is a Peruvian curandero and the originator of the Pachakuti Mesa Tradition, a cross-cultural form of shamanism built around the mesa, a ceremonial altar laid out as a map of the cosmos. Between 1969 and 1986 he served a long apprenticeship on Peru's northern coast with the healer don Celso Rojas Palomino, becoming his second in ceremony, and then studied for four years in the Andean paqo tradition with don Benito Corihuamán Vargas near Cusco, who gave him the altomisayoq initiation in 1985. He also trained in psychology at Duke and the State University of West Georgia and held a fellowship in ethnopsychology at Emory, work that fed into efforts to bring Peruvian folk healers into public mental health care.

His school, The Heart of the Healer (THOTH), trains students through in-person apprenticeships led by teachers he has sanctioned and through recorded courses he teaches himself. These cover building and working with a personal mesa, seasonal ceremony and offerings to Pachamama, journeying between the Upper and Lower Worlds, and the cosmology of the ancient temple at Chavín de Huántar. He has led pilgrimages to sacred sites in Peru and Bolivia since 1986, joins a weekly online gathering with his wife Cindy, and co-wrote Lessons in Courage with the anthropologist Bonnie Glass-Coffin.

books.title: Lessons in Courage: Peruvian Shamanic Wisdom for Everyday Life
books.author: Bonnie Glass-Coffin and Oscar Miro-Quesada
books.description: Written with the anthropologist Bonnie Glass-Coffin, this book tells his own story of apprenticeship and awakening in Peru and draws everyday lessons from it for readers on a spiritual path.

courses.title: Pachakuti Mesa Tradition Starter Bundle
courses.description: An entry-level set of recorded teachings for building and working with a Pachakuti Mesa, for newcomers or for practitioners restarting their practice.

courses.title: Awakening Your Universal Shamanic Self
courses.description: A seven-session recorded foundation course in which students build their own mesa and learn the principles shared across shamanic traditions. It is the suggested starting point for his other courses.

courses.title: Walker Between Worlds
courses.description: Three recorded sessions on serving as a bridge between the spiritual and material worlds, drawing on Hermetic teachings attributed to Thoth alongside Andean practice.

courses.title: Reverence, Ritual & Renewal
courses.description: A thirteen-session recorded initiation into Andean seasonal ceremony, including building apachetas and making offerings to Pachamama. A foundation course is recommended first.

courses.title: Fearless Freedom: Living the Perfection of Who You Are
courses.description: A recorded one-day virtual intensive of mystery-school teachings and practices exploring the upper, lower and inner dimensions of being. No prior shamanic experience is needed.

courses.title: Kimsa Intiman Tukuspa: Becoming the Three Suns
courses.description: A recorded one-day intensive on the cosmology and imagery of Chavín de Huántar, the ancient Peruvian temple he regards as the source of the country's healing traditions. Open to all.

Only one photo: his YouTube avatar. It matches the man in an event flyer on his site; the site has no clean single headshot.

Plant medicine: his early lineage is the north-coast huachuma (San Pedro) tradition and his About page lists an interview on Amazonian plant medicine, but his teaching as offered is mesa work, ceremony and journeying; plant-medicine rule not applied. Owner may want to look.
Videos are summit talks on his own channel; most other uploads are recordings of the school's weekly Wednesday Night Link-Ups led by various teachers.
His About page also mentions teaching at Omega and Esalen in the past; no current programme there is shown, so no hub link added.
